title: myProjects
intro: Here are some of my projects

items.title: Nexus Tools
description: A tool to generate secure passwords with various options for length and complexity. An easy-to-use calculator for determining percentages in real time. Roman Numeral Converter

items.title: Katana in a stone
description: Try to pull out the katana from the stone. With a 1/2 chance.
A very simple 3D game made with Three.js

items.title: ToDo App
description: The classic ToDo app with the ability to add, delete, and mark as done tasks.
React front-end app with a PHP and MySQL back-end.

items.title: Sandrine Coupart
description: A website for Sandrine Coupart, a fictional dietitian, featuring healthy recipes, user comments, evaluations, and a contact form. It’s designed to promote wellness through an engaging and functional user experience.

items.title: Sandrine Coupart CMS
description: This project is a content management system (CMS) designed for managing allergens, recipes, user accounts, reviews, and testimonials for the website of Sandrine Coupart, a fictional entity.

items.title: Car workshop "Garage V. Parrot"
description: This project is a web site and a CMS designed for managing the website of Garage V. Parrot, a fictional entity specialized in car services and used cars sales.
